question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Viscous
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e. **'Watery'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word **"Viscous" **refers to a substance that has a thick, sticky consistency between solid and liquid.
 
• It is derived from the Latin word **"viscosus"**, meaning sticky, viscid.(चिपचिपा)
 
• The **correct antonym** is **"Watery"**.
 
• **"Watery"** is the **opposite **of **"viscous"** as it refers to something that is thin, often in a way that is not attractive or beneficial, much like water. (पानी की तरह)

Therefore, the **correct answer **is: **'Watery'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's take a look at the other options:
 
 
• **"Grim"** means depressing or worrying to consider.(निराशाजनक)
 
• **"Brutal"** means savagely violent or harsh(निर्दयी)
 
• **"Thick"** refers to the density of a substance(मोटा)
